result.description:
Make a real impact on employee wellbeing and recovery - APS5 to EL1 opportunities available now  We're currently looking to speak with experienced Rehabilitation Officers about a range of upcoming opportunities within a large Federal Government organisation based in Canberra.   
 Whether you're looking for a contract, permanent role or are interested in a Section 26 transfer, we'd love to hear from you. 
   
 These positions will see you supporting employees through injury management and return-to-work programmes, while working closely with managers, health practitioners and other key stakeholders to achieve positive outcomes. 
   What you'll be doing    
 
 Managing rehabilitation and return-to-work cases 
 Developing and monitoring recovery-at-work plans 
 Providing advice around injury management and workplace adjustments 
 Liaising with employees, managers, medical providers and relevant stakeholders 
 Supporting a positive approach to employee wellbeing and recovery 
 Ensuring processes align with relevant legislation and policy frameworks 
 
   What we are looking for    
 We're keen to hear from people with experience in: 
   
 
 Rehabilitation and injury management 
 Return-to-work coordination 
 Case management 
 WHS or employee wellbeing 
 Workers compensation or Comcare environments 
 
 You'll be a strong communicator, comfortable building relationships with a variety of stakeholders and able to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
   Security Clearance  
 An NV1 clearance would be fantastic, but it's certainly not essential. 
 Our client is open to building a pipeline of strong candidates who are eligible to obtain a clearance and willing to go through the process.  This could be a great opportunity for someone currently in a stable role or on a longer-term contract who is open to planning their next move. 
   What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunities from APS5 through to EL1 equivalent levels 
 Contract, permanent and Section 26 options available 
 Supportive teams and meaningful work 
 Future career opportunities within the Federal Government sector 
 Competitive remuneration based on experience 
 
 If you're interested in learning more, apply now or reach out to the Hays Canberra team for a confidential chat. 
 Please note: Australian Citizenship is required, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain an NV1 security clearance. 
   What you need to do now     Call me on 02 6112 7639 to discuss or email your CV to orlena.prosser@hays.com.au      Orlena Prosser Recruitment Team Manager | Human Resources     Please  click here  to apply.
